fields.to: Unified Command; Command and General Staff; Airline Station Managers; TSA FSD
fields.summary: IT confirmed unauthorized administrator access to the AODB SQL master from workstation OPS_INTERN_03 (192.168.1.55). A script (random_gate_generator.ps1) altered 142 active flight records at 1005. At 1100 the IC ordered all FIDS screens dark; whiteboard teams with megaphones are directing passengers. TSA moved to manual ID checks after boarding-pass scanners rejected mismatched flight data. A crowd crush developed at Gate C4 and is being managed by NCIA Police. No injuries reported.
